title: RealityEngine Agent Behavior (runtime-neutral)
description: What an agent bound to a machine does, independent of the runtime that hosts it (OpenClaw today, ACP-hosted agents after OpenClaw's sunset in v0.0.3). A runtime adapter renders a behavior into its own artifact: localOpenClawStack/machine-behaviors/runtimes/openclaw.py into an OC agent, runtimes/acp.py into an ACP session plan. Nothing in a behavior names a runtime, a gateway, a session key or a tool implementation: tools are abstract capabilities, which each adapter maps to its own tools (for ACP, to the MCP servers it passes per session). The vector contract is the machine's agentBinding, unchanged: the PE completion Source the agent's result arrives through.

behaviorId.description: Stable id of this behavior; renderers derive runtime ids from it.

role.description: input-analyst produces a machine's input vector from observations; output-actor acts on a CES output; step-agent runs one asset-workflow step on a clone (dispatched with the frame's capability); watchdog-agent is dispatched by a fixture's CES; deterministic-tool is a non-LLM step (for example a canonical diff renderer) that still answers through the same completion contract.

agentId.description: Runtime-safe id (64 characters at most, the strictest limit any adapter has today).

file.description: The machine's corpus file name (its file stem is what cloneable rule 1 and document handoffs name).

mode.description: ces-trigger: the PE dispatches when one of triggerSequenceIds asserts (triggerConfig rules); frame-step: the asset-workflow dispatcher dispatches when the frame's step clones this machine, handing the agent the assetID, the step's capability and its scopes, nothing else. observation-request: an input-analyst invoked when observations arrive or on request, to produce the machine's input vector; it names no CES.

workflow.description: The agentic workflow (agentic-workflow-contract.json) this behavior serves.

humanApprovalRequired.description: True when the agent's work is followed by a human approval step it can never perform (T15).

capabilities.description: Abstract tool grants. An adapter grants exactly these and nothing else; a capability an adapter cannot provide is a render failure, never a silent drop.

instructions.description: Runtime-neutral system instructions. They never name the hosting runtime; an adapter may prefix its own framing.

responseMapping.description: How the agent's textual or structured answer becomes completion values: localOpenClawStack/machine-behaviors/RESPONSE_MAPPING.md, response-mapping.schema.json.

runtimeBindings.description: Optional per-runtime overrides an adapter reads (model, timeouts, legacy ids). Keyed by runtime name; never required for a behavior to render.

documentAssetWorkflow.description: The machine's document-workflow duty (IFRS and other document domains), carried unchanged.

capability.description: frame.read/frame.return.write/pod.read/pod.write: the asset lifecycle through the step's capability (pod writes under the pinned ETag). pe.completion.write: answer through the agentBinding writeBack. pe.observations.read: the PE's current state and source observations. kline.read: engine K-line histories. regression.report.read: CI regression run reports. registry.read: the instance registry. rag.query: localAIStack retrieval. pki.crl.read: the lane PKI's revocation list. lifecycle.frame.open: open a new asset frame (no approval). lifecycle.continuation.invalidate: invalidate parked continuations signed by a revoked principal. egress.message.annotate/hold: add provenance to, or hold, an outbound ACP/MCP message. delegation.clamp: reduce A2A delegation depth. human.notify: route a request to named human roles.
